attBesluta.text: Excellent for the mudroom, handled tradies with filthy boots really well. Comes up like new once shake/vacuumed. The price was a bonus. very satisfied with this mat. Hope to buy same in a smaller size, when available.

Got it for my furball, she's ancient and pees in the carpet. This carpet is superb, looks great, and doesn't keep the pee's odor. All you have to do is rinse it and let it dry in the sun for a few hours. So far, so good!
Bought for when friens come round to play mahjong. Very sturdy and folds away neatly when not in use. Good value

Ik heb de kaarttafel (majong) eind juli gekocht en ben er super blij mee. Ik gebruik hem als bridgetafel. Wist niet dat hij dubbel geklapt kon worden, dus wilde hem eerst terugsturen maar toen de doos samen met de bezorger open gemaakt, was het helemaal goed. Ook het groene kleedje staat gezellig. Dus een goede recensie mijnerzijds. Vr. Gr.
I now have 3 of these tables...very portable since they fold in half. LOVE that they came with a cloth table cover with elastic corners.
Our 2nd portable table. Lot it! Bring and pop up anywhere you go.
Wonderful table for board games and puzzles. So well made and convenient. Love that it folds into small size. Good price. Sturdy. 10 stars
Although I haven’t used it yet, it looks steady n will be useful. Variety of functions beyond mahjong. The green cover is too flimsy.
Not as comfortable as I hoped, nevertheless the backrest with the rocking limiting stopper makes it very acceptable.

I put these behind my kitchen sink as a splashback alternative and they work great. The 3D effect is stunning and the matte white hides smudges well. Water just beads off—I wipe it down daily. Finally a decorative wall solution that's practical too.

These panels turned my plain wall into a statement piece. The floral 3D pattern catches light beautifully and creates this modern, art-gallery vibe. They're lightweight, easy to score and snap, and I installed them solo in about 3 hours with construction glue. Obsessed.
Great value, made a bad ceiling look great for very little money
